name: 35777-decode-qwen35-27b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine.
architecture: 27B hybrid-attention decoder, BF16, 64 layers, ~55.6 GB of weights. The checkpoint also carries a small vision tower, unused here.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 30 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 35777.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 2048 prompt tokens and 1024 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0, one turn. The engine renders and tokenizes the prompt, so the report shows a prompt count a few tokens above 2048; that is not drift.
purpose: A single-user long-form writing assistant on one 27B model and one GPU, turning 2000-word briefs into page-length drafts.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Engine: commit 1bc9c77f6d324bf7b9253b0c78626fbc50286bfb
# (`git describe --tags` -> v0.17.0rc0-167-g1bc9c77f6d32), a source checkout, not a release.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
# KEEP THIS ON ONE LINE -- a block-form mapping here is not read, and the key would be lost.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 0, "video": 0}
